diameter_basis: Finite-cloud ball bound, not a continuous diameter certificate

moving_fixed.scope: Exact phase minimization for finite supplied spatial samples only; not a continuous reach certificate.

moving_moving.distant_pair_rule: All chord lengths >=2*tau have nonnegative normal-chord margin for unit normals.
moving_moving.scope: Finite spatial pair sample; common rigid rotations preserve these margins exactly.

fixed_fixed.distant_pair_rule: All chord lengths >=2*tau have nonnegative normal-chord margin for unit normals.
fixed_fixed.scope: Finite spatial pair sample; common rigid rotations preserve these margins exactly.

display_query_adapter.definition: Only generated display query radii within 32 binary64 eps*max(1,|endpoints|) are merged; named landmarks and endpoints take priority. No source radial node, coefficient, field or parameter is moved.
